newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire Elec leaps after agreed bid.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire Elec leaps after agreed bid.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc were indicated sharply higher in pre-market trade on Monday after the regional electricity group said it had agreed to a 1.5 billion stg cash offer from a U.S. group.
The shares were up 66-1/2p at 885p by 0813 GMT. Earlier the UK electricity group confirmed the offer from a company owned by American Electric Power Co Inc and Public Service Co of Colorado.
The bid values the shares at 927p each.
Others in the sector were also lifted by the news. Southern Electric was indicated 36p higher at 782-1/2p.
Yorkshire and Southern remain the only regional electricity companies in England and Wales which are still independent. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
